name: Photo mode saves each photo to photos/
body: New engine function lantern:::screen:::Capture(path) asks the host to save the next rendered frame as a PNG; photo mode calls it after the flash, writing photos/ with a numbered name. Photo mode did not save pictures before (docs/photo-mode.md).

comments.text: Already done by lantern #190 (D-214): lantern:::screen:::Capture writes photos/photo-N.png. My duplicate PR was closed.

acceptance_criteria: A taken photo writes a PNG under photos/
A host test covers the request
